summary.text: Anne Westbrook is a Democratic state representative from Savannah who has represented Georgia House District 163 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A lawyer and former legislative aide, she holds a law degree from the University of Georgia.

paragraphs.text: She graduated from Savannah Christian Preparatory School, earned a B.A. in political science from Hollins College and a J.D. from the University of Georgia, and has worked as a lawyer and a legislative aide.
Westbrook ran in the 2020 Democratic primary for House District 163 and lost the August 2020 runoff to Derek Mallow.
In 2022 she defeated Weslyn Bowers in the Democratic primary and won the general election, and she won re-election in 2024.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Economic Development and Tourism, Judiciary, and State Planning and Community Affairs committees.
